title: Two Sisters with Puppy, Shaded Park Bench - Vintage 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot from circa 1930 depicting two young girls sitting side by side on a slatted wooden park bench under the shade of a lush palm tree. The older girl on the left wears a dotted sleeveless summer dress, while the younger girl wears a light-colored dress and sits beside a small fluffy puppy or toy dog. Both wear classic low-cut shoes and sport popular early 20th-century bobbed hairstyles.
